text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I managed to win the Hanshin JF somehow! 
Yay...♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
It was really tough, but thanks to 
Trainer's care, my body doesn't feel as 
strained as before.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Trainer got praised, too... ♪ Maybe 
meeting each other "right now" was 
actually... super important?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case... I want to give 
Trainer a victory in a big race again! 
I'll take on the Tiara route—the Oka Sho!
